note: Documented + gap-filled Chain Insights graph query recipes. Live native traversal forms (BFS/WSHORTEST/KSHORTEST/var-length) are bounded per the R2 resource policy and verified against real Memgraph. Merged into the corpus by generate-query-corpus.mjs; archive/facts recipes drive the translator conformance + T0b baselines.

recipes.query: USE archive_topology MATCH (src:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, flow.period_granularity AS period_granularity, flow.period_start_date AS period_start_date, flow.period_end_date AS period_end_date, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Archive FLOWS_TO edge sample with period granularity/start/end plus amount_usd_sum and tx_count

recipes.query: USE archive_topology MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_ADDRESS]->(m:Address) RETURN i.identity_id AS identity_id, m.address AS member_address, m.network AS member_network LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Archive identity-to-member-address sample (identity_id, member_address, member_network)

recipes.query: USE archive_topology MATCH (src:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) RETURN dst.identity_id AS to_identity, flow.period_granularity AS period_granularity, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 50
recipes.description: Archive flow history for one identity ordered by last_seen_timestamp descending

recipes.query: USE archive_topology MATCH (src:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, flow.period_granularity AS period_granularity, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Recent historical archive flow edges globally ordered by last_seen_timestamp

recipes.query: USE archive_topology MATCH (:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(:Identity) RETURN flow.period_granularity AS period_granularity, count(flow) AS flow_edges LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Count archive FLOWS_TO edges grouped by period_granularity

recipes.query: USE archive_topology MATCH (src:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) WHERE flow.period_granularity = "daily" RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Filter archive flows to daily granularity, ranked by USD sum

recipes.query: USE archive_topology MATCH (t:TopologySnapshot) RETURN t.graph_name AS graph_name, t.topology_tier AS topology_tier, t.default_period_granularity AS default_period_granularity, t.min_period_start_date AS min_period_start_date, t.max_period_end_date AS max_period_end_date, t.available_granularities AS available_granularities LIMIT 10
recipes.description: TopologySnapshot node projection from archive_topology_snapshot_view — fills the entirely-uncovered TopologySnapshot label (the archive topology metadata surface).

recipes.query: USE archive_topology MATCH (src:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) WHERE flow.amount_usd_sum IS NOT NULL RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.period_granularity AS period_granularity ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Archive FLOWS_TO with an IS NOT NULL WHERE filter and ORDER BY on amount_usd_sum — fills the missing archive-layer is-null filter (present on live_topology but not archive).

recipes.query: USE archive_topology MATCH (:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(:Identity) RETURN DISTINCT flow.period_granularity AS period_granularity LIMIT 10
recipes.description: DISTINCT projection of FLOWS_TO.period_granularity — fills the entirely-missing archive-layer DISTINCT feature.

recipes.query: USE archive_topology MATCH (src:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) WITH dst, sum(flow.amount_usd_sum) AS total_usd, count(flow) AS flow_edges RETURN dst.identity_id AS to_identity, total_usd, flow_edges ORDER BY total_usd DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Archive top-counterparties aggregate from the fixture Identity: WITH sum(amount_usd_sum) + count grouped by destination, ORDER BY total DESC — the archive counterpart to recipe_live_topology_07, fills archive grouped SUM aggregate + order-by (archive_05 was count-only). [WITH-aggregate: out of archive translator scope — expected ErrUnsupportedShape]

recipes.query: USE archive_topology MATCH (src:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, CASE WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum > 100000 THEN "high" WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum > 1000 THEN "medium" ELSE "low" END AS amount_band LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Archive FLOWS_TO CASE expression banding amount_usd_sum — the archive counterpart to recipe_live_topology_08, fills archive-layer case-expression coverage.

recipes.query: USE archive_topology MATCH (i:Identity) RETURN count(i) AS identity_count LIMIT 1
recipes.description: Node-only Identity count on the archive layer — the archive counterpart to recipe_live_topology_14, fills archive node-only aggregate coverage.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_FEATURE]->(f:AddressFeature) RETURN i.identity_id AS identity_id, f.tx_out_count AS tx_out_count, f.tx_in_count AS tx_in_count LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Facts-layer identity feature enrichment via HAS_FEATURE (tx_out_count, tx_in_count)

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (i:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[:HAS_LABEL]->(label:AddressLabel) RETURN label.label AS label, label.entity_type AS entity_type, label.source AS source LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Facts label lookup for one identity returning label, entity_type, source

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (i:Identity) RETURN i.identity_id AS identity_id, i.labels AS labels, i.is_exchange AS is_exchange LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Facts Identity projection returning identity_id, labels, risk_level

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_RISK_SCORE]->(r:RiskScore) RETURN i.identity_id AS identity_id, r.risk_score AS risk_score, r.window_days AS window_days, r.xgboost_model_version AS xgboost_model_version LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Join identities to their RiskScore facts (score, level, model version)

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (a:Asset) WHERE a.coingecko_id IS NOT NULL RETURN a.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol, a.asset_contract AS asset_contract, a.pricing_tier AS pricing_tier, a.verified AS verified ORDER BY a.asset_symbol ASC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Asset node projection through the facts_assets_view with an is-null WHERE filter and ORDER BY — fills the entirely-uncovered Asset label plus facts-layer is-null and order-by coverage. Asset has no edge to Identity in the mapping, so it is correctly a standalone node lookup.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (n:NeuronEndpoint) WHERE n.netuid = 15 RETURN n.endpoint_id AS endpoint_id, n.coldkey_address AS coldkey_address, n.hotkey_address AS hotkey_address, n.netuid AS netuid, n.ip_address AS ip_address, n.axon_port AS axon_port ORDER BY n.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: NeuronEndpoint standalone node projection from facts_neuron_endpoints_view with a numeric netuid predicate (fixture netuid 15) and ORDER BY — fills the NeuronEndpoint label and a numeric WHERE on the endpoints view.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (i:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[hne:HAS_NEURON_ENDPOINT]->(n:NeuronEndpoint) RETURN n.endpoint_id AS endpoint_id, hne.netuid AS netuid, hne.hotkey_address AS hotkey_address, hne.ip_address AS ip_address, hne.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY hne.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: HAS_NEURON_ENDPOINT fixed-hop from the fixture Identity (coldkey_address join) to NeuronEndpoint, projecting relationship + node properties with ORDER BY — fills the HAS_NEURON_ENDPOINT edge.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (i:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[reg:REGISTERED_NEURON]->(h:Hotkey) WHERE reg.netuid = 15 RETURN h.address AS hotkey_address, reg.netuid AS netuid, reg.observation_count AS observation_count, reg.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY reg.last_seen_timestamp DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: REGISTERED_NEURON fixed-hop from the fixture Identity to Hotkey with a relationship netuid WHERE filter (fixture netuid 15) and ORDER BY — fills the REGISTERED_NEURON edge, the Hotkey label via edge target, and facts-layer relationship-property WHERE.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (h:Hotkey) RETURN h.address AS address, h.netuids AS netuids, h.observation_count AS observation_count, h.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, h.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY h.observation_count DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Hotkey standalone node projection from facts_neuron_hotkeys_view (a DIFFERENT table than the endpoints edge view) with ORDER BY on observation_count — ensures the dedicated hotkeys view is translated, not only the endpoints-derived edge.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (i:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[:REGISTERED_NEURON]->(h:Hotkey)-[sf:SERVED_FROM]->(ip:IPAddress) RETURN h.address AS hotkey_address, ip.ip_address AS ip_address, sf.axon_port AS axon_port, sf.prometheus_port AS prometheus_port, sf.netuid AS netuid LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Two-hop neuron join REGISTERED_NEURON then SERVED_FROM (Identity->Hotkey->IPAddress, all backed by facts_neuron_endpoints_view) — fills the SERVED_FROM edge, the IPAddress label via edge target, and multi-hop translator join coverage on the facts layer.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (i:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[op:OPERATED_FROM]->(ip:IPAddress) WHERE op.netuid = 15 RETURN ip.ip_address AS ip_address, op.netuid AS netuid, op.hotkey_address AS hotkey_address, op.axon_port AS axon_port, op.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp LIMIT 25
recipes.description: OPERATED_FROM fixed-hop from the fixture Identity (coldkey_address) directly to IPAddress with a relationship netuid WHERE filter (fixture netuid 15) — fills the OPERATED_FROM edge.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (ip:IPAddress) RETURN ip.ip_address AS ip_address, ip.netuids AS netuids, ip.observation_count AS observation_count, ip.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY ip.observation_count DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: IPAddress standalone node projection from facts_neuron_ip_addresses_view (a DIFFERENT table than the endpoints edge view) with ORDER BY — ensures the dedicated IP view is translated independently of the neuron-endpoint edges.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_LABEL]->(l:AddressLabel) RETURN l.label AS label, count(l) AS label_count ORDER BY label_count DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: HAS_LABEL aggregate over AddressLabel grouped by label value with count and ORDER BY — fills the missing facts-layer aggregate and order-by (grouped GROUP BY projection through the translator).

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_LABEL]->(l:AddressLabel) RETURN DISTINCT l.entity_type AS entity_type LIMIT 25
recipes.description: DISTINCT projection of AddressLabel.entity_type over HAS_LABEL — fills the entirely-missing facts-layer DISTINCT feature.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_RISK_SCORE]->(r:RiskScore) WHERE r.risk_score IS NOT NULL RETURN i.identity_id AS identity_id, r.risk_score AS risk_score, r.window_days AS window_days, r.processing_date AS processing_date ORDER BY r.risk_score DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: HAS_RISK_SCORE with an IS NOT NULL WHERE filter and ORDER BY on risk_score — fills facts-layer is-null and WHERE-clause coverage on the RiskScore view.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_FEATURE]->(f:AddressFeature) RETURN f.feature_scope AS feature_scope, count(f) AS features, sum(f.total_volume_usd) AS total_volume_usd ORDER BY total_volume_usd DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: HAS_FEATURE numeric aggregation: count and sum(total_volume_usd) grouped by feature_scope with ORDER BY — fills facts-layer numeric SUM aggregation (distinct from the count-only aggregate) over the AddressFeature view.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (i:Identity) RETURN count(i) AS identity_count LIMIT 1
recipes.description: Node-only Identity count on the facts layer — the facts-layer counterpart to recipe_live_topology_14, fills facts node-only aggregate coverage.

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (i:Identity) RETURN i.identity_id AS identity_id, i.labels AS labels, i.risk_score AS risk_score, i.risk_level AS risk_level, i.is_exchange AS is_exchange LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Live Identity projection returning identity_id, labels, risk_score, risk_level, is_exchange

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (src:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Live FLOWS_TO edge sample with from/to identity, amount_usd_sum, tx_count, first/last seen timestamps

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (i:Identity)-[:HAS_ADDRESS]->(m:Address) RETURN i.identity_id AS identity_id, m.address AS member_address, m.network AS member_network LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Live identity-to-member-address sample (identity_id, member_address, member_network)

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (m:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})<-[:HAS_ADDRESS]-(i:Identity) RETURN i.identity_id AS identity_id LIMIT 1
recipes.description: Resolve a member address (SS58 or 0x EVM-pallet) to its owning identity via reverse HAS_ADDRESS

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (src:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) RETURN dst.identity_id AS to_identity, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 50
recipes.description: Top live outflows from one identity ordered by amount_usd_sum descending

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (src:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Top live FLOWS_TO edges globally ranked by USD sum (no source filter)

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (src:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) WITH src, count(dst) AS out_degree, sum(flow.amount_usd_sum) AS total_usd RETURN src.identity_id AS identity_id, out_degree, total_usd ORDER BY out_degree DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Rank source identities by live out-degree and total transferred USD

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (src:Identity)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, CASE WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum IS NULL THEN "unknown" WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum >= 100000 THEN "large" WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum >= 10000 THEN "medium" ELSE "small" END AS amount_bucket, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Bucket live flow edges into unknown/large/medium/small by USD amount via CASE

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (m:Address) WHERE m.address STARTS WITH "5Ggf" RETURN m.address AS address, m.network AS member_network LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Prefix search over member Address nodes via STARTS WITH for address completion

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (:Identity)-[:HAS_ADDRESS]->(m:Address) RETURN m.network AS member_network, count(m) AS addresses ORDER BY addresses DESC LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Address-family census: count of member addresses grouped by network

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (src:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5c5z7rcnbprwg2ehdpcwcqecvrquc2tqecpwtgvsb9v6hhz8"}) RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, 1 AS hops, r1.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, r1.tx_count AS tx_count LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Direct one-hop FLOWS_TO edge between two named identities (graph_query_batch hop_1)

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (src:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO]->(mid:Identity)-[r2:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Identity) WHERE mid.is_exchange IS NULL RETURN src.identity_id AS from_identity, mid.identity_id AS mid_identity, dst.identity_id AS to_identity, 2 AS hops, r1.amount_usd_sum AS first_amount_usd, r2.amount_usd_sum AS second_amount_usd LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Fixed two-hop FLOWS_TO expansion from a source, skipping exchange intermediates (graph_query_batch hop_2)

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (i:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[:HAS_ADDRESS]->(m:Address) RETURN i.identity_id AS identity_id, m.address AS member_address, m.network AS member_network LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Forward member-address enumeration for one named identity (inline-filtered HAS_ADDRESS)

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (i:Identity) RETURN count(i) AS count LIMIT 1
recipes.description: Count of Identity nodes in live topology

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH p = (a:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[:FLOWS_TO *1..5]->(b:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5c5z7rcnbprwg2ehdpcwcqecvrquc2tqecpwtgvsb9v6hhz8"}) RETURN p LIMIT 3
recipes.description: GQL quantified-path form: bind and return any single shortest FLOWS_TO path (1-5 hops) between two anonymous nodes

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH path = (src:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[:FLOWS_TO *BFS 1..5]->(dst:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5c5z7rcnbprwg2ehdpcwcqecvrquc2tqecpwtgvsb9v6hhz8"}) RETURN path LIMIT 5
recipes.description: Direct-Memgraph reference (rejected by hosted path): native BFS path between two identities — retained as a negative/grammar-coverage shape

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH path = (src:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"})-[:FLOWS_TO *WSHORTEST 5 (r, n | coalesce(r.amount_usd_sum, 1)) total_weight]->(dst:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5c5z7rcnbprwg2ehdpcwcqecvrquc2tqecpwtgvsb9v6hhz8"}) RETURN path, total_weight LIMIT 5
recipes.description: Direct-Memgraph reference (rejected by hosted path): weighted shortest path minimizing summed amount_usd_sum weight — retained as a negative/grammar-coverage shape

recipes.query: USE live_topology MATCH (src:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5hbdz6uluwzegamspas2kaufblmdaht5t48rcdrqatsggcar"}), (dst:Identity {identity_id: "bittensor:5c5z7rcnbprwg2ehdpcwcqecvrquc2tqecpwtgvsb9v6hhz8"}) WITH src, dst MATCH path = (src)-[:FLOWS_TO *KSHORTEST|3]->(dst) RETURN path LIMIT 3
recipes.description: Direct-Memgraph reference (rejected by hosted path): K shortest (k=3) path alternatives between two identities — retained as a negative/grammar-coverage shape
